cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Quilladin
cards.description: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights.

cards.name: Chesnaught
cards.description: Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Braixen
cards.description: It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

cards.name: Delphox
cards.description: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: Its instinct is to bury itself in holes. It often steals the nesting holes of others to sleep in them.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle filling its body with power and changing its form.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

cards.name: Bergmite
cards.description: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

cards.name: Avalugg
cards.description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its enormous frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.description: It's nature's cleaner-it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.description: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its patagial membranes and released while it is gliding.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Deoxys
cards.description: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting that power.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It's kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo
cards.description: It was recently discovered that the different varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but also in the size of the souls they collect.

cards.name: Xerneas
cards.description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

cards.name: Phanpy
cards.description: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.

cards.name: Donphan
cards.description: Donphan is normally a calm Pokemon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

cards.name: Qwilfish
cards.description: Experienced fishers say they try to catch Qwilfish in the brief moment that these Pokemon become defenseless just after launching poisonous spikes.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokemon sprays liquid poison to take down prey that approach unawares.

cards.name: Beldum
cards.description: They communicate with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

cards.name: Metagross
cards.description: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

cards.name: Ferroseed
cards.description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

cards.name: Ferrothorn
cards.description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

cards.name: Goomy
cards.description: Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body punches or kicks from its enemies slide right off it.

cards.name: Sliggoo
cards.description: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

cards.name: Goodra
cards.description: This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: Using luminescent matter within its body, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: These Pokemon like things neat and tidy. They are always sweeping and dusting their habitat, using their tails as brooms.
